C-54.Name: Mermaid in light and dark: white node cards in light themes, edge labels on the diagram panel
C-54.Summary: Found on the 2.3.1 marketing captures; user 2026-10-17: «чини». (1) Since C-51 T-012 the light themes draw flowchart nodes grey: the white theme surface fails the «distinct from panel» gate against the light code panel, so the fill falls back to a 12 % text-over-panel blend. (2) Edge labels («approved», «yes», «no») paint their box in the PAGE background while the diagram sits on the CODE PANEL — in dark themes a black rectangle on the grey panel, in light ones a white patch; at fit-to-column scale the labels read as dark smudges.

Problem.Description: T-012 derived node colours against the panel for dark themes but applied the same distinctness gate to light themes, where a node is a card outlined by its ≥ 3:1 border; edge-label backgrounds were never moved from the page colour to the panel.

Goals.R-1: Light themes: the node fill is the theme surface (white card) whenever that surface is lighter than the panel and keeps the node text ≥ 4.5:1; the border keeps ≥ 3:1 on the panel. Dark themes keep the T-012 derivation unchanged.
Goals.R-2: Edge labels and label backgrounds take the panel colour; the label text keeps ≥ 4.5:1 on the panel (the muted token when it passes, else the theme text).

Constraints.Item: mainBkg/nodeBorder stay unset so %%{init}%% overrides keep working; every registered theme stays gate-checked.

NonGoals.Item: Task-list checkbox spacing and other diagram types' palettes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1, R-2 done; grace lint 0; full unit + e2e green.

VerificationIntent.Item: Per-theme unit gates (card rule for light themes, label contrast on the panel for all); full unit + e2e green; README and canvas captures re-shot.
